note: Truth is the tags and only the tags. A frame no tag speaks for is not scored in either direction.

unaided.what_it_means: the holder inference with no human input at all, scored against a person for the first time

held_out.what_it_means: two thirds of the tags given as hard constraints, the other third withheld from the solver and scored

calibration.why: only 0 held-out frames; a curve fitted to that would be a shape, not a calibration

calibration_note: Accuracy against held-out tags, grouped by the solver's own min-marginal margin in yards. This is the only honest source of a stopping threshold: the physics checks in ur.disc can say a sequence is implausible and can never say a plausible one is right.
